text: {"facts":[{"statement":"The variables, in declared order, are v1, v2, v3, v4, v5, and v6.","source_ids":["task"]},{"statement":"Each variable must be an integer from 0 through 5 inclusive.","source_ids":["bounds"]},{"statement":"The coefficients weighted by v1 through v6 must be congruent to 4 modulo 5 for q1.","source_ids":["q1"]},{"statement":"The coefficients weighted by v1 through v6 must be congruent to 3 modulo 7 for q2.","source_ids":["q2"]},{"statement":"The coefficients weighted by v1 through v6 must be congruent to 0 modulo 11 for q3.","source_ids":["q3"]},{"statement":"The coefficients weighted by v1 through v6 must be congruent to 0 modulo 7 for q4.","source_ids":["q4"]},{"statement":"The requested result is an object of the form {\"values\":[...]} with values in declared variable order.","source_ids":["task"]}],"open_requirements":["Find and verify an integer tuple satisfying all four modular constraints and the bounds, then return it in the required format."],"tentative_options":[{"id":"enumeration","method":"Enumerate all tuples in the bounded domain and retain those satisfying every congruence.","unverified_assumptions":[]},{"id":"pruned-search","method":"Search variable assignments incrementally, pruning branches when modular constraints cannot be satisfied by remaining variables.","unverified_assumptions":["A sound pruning condition can be derived for each partially assigned constraint."]},{"id":"constraint-solver","method":"Encode the bounded integer variables and modular equalities in a constraint or integer solver, then verify any returned tuple directly.","unverified_assumptions":["An appropriate solver is available and correctly supports these modular constraints."]}],"possible_checks":["Check every returned value is an integer between 0 and 5 inclusive.","Compute each coefficient-weighted sum and verify its specified residue modulo the corresponding modulus.","Confirm the values are listed in the order v1 through v6."]}
